args.context: We are constructing a read-only diagnostic for positive photon birth quadrature in a Bianchi-I radiation/chemistry solver. A birth-age panel [l,r] in normalized age x has width d, constant reference optical depth tau, and two equal emitted weights d/2 at symmetric interior ages m plus or minus a displacement. Exponential fitting sets cosh(tau displacement)=sinh(tau d/2)/(tau d/2), preserving emitted mass, emitted first moment, and frozen survivor mass. We need exact panel mass and age-moment identities, Wasserstein-1 support-width bounds and mass-matched composition, and a careful distinction between this constant-source/opacity reference and actual positive cohort weights, physical rounded birth clocks, and variable-opacity native transport. We will independently verify symbolic identities and limiting behavior; no nonlinear gas error bound is inferred from reference accuracy alone.

calls.public_response_retention: Guidance status only; context is not a mathematical derivation

calls.result_summary: Five exact defects/identities returned zero; emitted second defect and uniform W1 returned the claimed polynomials. Zero-opacity limits returned d and 1/2 together with Power::infy/Infinity::indet warnings.
Taylor constant coefficient is d, conditional mean series is 1/2-u/12+u^3/720, GL2 second defect is 0, and the countercondition to uniform W1 in [1/8,1/4] reduced to False.
